items.title: No costing of a switch from paper to app diaries
items.whyItMatters: The clinic manager's decision is financial, and no retrieved study prices it.
items.opportunity: Cost set-up time, appointment time, repeat appointments and preventive prescriptions before and after the switch.

items.title: The preventive budget consequence is projected, not observed
items.whyItMatters: The largest cost may fall outside the clinic (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Observe preventive prescriptions before and after, and report the budget impact separately.

items.title: Patients without smartphones
items.whyItMatters: Older patients may lose usable diaries if paper is withdrawn.
items.opportunity: Keep paper, and report usable diaries by age group and diary type.

items.title: Definition of a usable diary
items.whyItMatters: Completeness can be defined many ways.
items.opportunity: Adopt the consensus definition of 28 consecutive prospective days.

reevaluation: Both candidate questions are live; the evidence answers completeness better than it answers cost.
summary: Four gaps; the missing costing is high severity.
